description.value: Golden Dragon is a family-run Chinese restaurant established in Abbotsford in 1999 by chef Gang Shi, who brought 12 years of experience from Beijing's Palace Hotel. The menu spans Mandarin, Cantonese, and Szechuan cooking across a wide range of beef, chicken, pork, seafood, and vegetarian dishes, with most items cooked to order. It operates as a casual, full-service dine-in restaurant and also offers pickup orders.
